constraints.description: Never scan directories, grep raw HTML dumps, or run background tasks to discover student IDs, class groups, or LMS backend routes. Use deterministic harness commands for instant O(1) lookups.
Session cookies, JSESSIONID values, and authentication tokens must remain in process memory only. Writing them to any persistent file (source code, artifacts, logs, fixtures) is forbidden.
allowedAlternatives: Keep session values in process memory ($env: environment variables only)
Use authorized browser tool for bounded passive inspection
constraints.sourceRule: AGENTS.md#Actual academy data and production writes

constraints.description: File modifications, creations, deletions, and command executions (mutating tool calls) are capped at 3 per single agent turn. Intermediate verification and self-reflection steps are mandatory between groups of mutating calls.
allowedAlternatives: Batch at most 3 mutating calls per turn, then pause for verification
constraints.sourceRule: Legacy Antigravity runtime policy; see agent-runtime/README.md

constraints.description: Unknown or unverified data (student records, route contracts, LMS backend joins) must be explicitly marked as unknown or pending. Inventing plausible-sounding values is forbidden.
allowedAlternatives: Use bun run harness verify to confirm data before use

constraints.description: Triggering Kakao message sends programmatically is forbidden. The teacher retains sole send responsibility through the official sender. No automated send trigger may be invoked.
allowedAlternatives: Prepare the message payload and present it to the teacher for manual send

constraints.description: Prefer replace_file_content for targeted, contiguous edits over full file rewrites via write_to_file (Overwrite: true). Full rewrites consume excessive tokens and risk context pollution.
allowedAlternatives: Use replace_file_content for any edit to an existing file
Use write_to_file (Overwrite: true) only for brand-new files or complete structural refactors
constraints.sourceRule: Legacy Antigravity runtime policy; see agent-runtime/README.md
